Use issued ForecastOwnerRequest/profile/rule and explicit split/horizon/method/params/seed; train-only producer pairs actual heldout observations to persisted forecast intervals, recomputes counts/rate, and persists distinct report/evidence/candidate receipt.

A same-CAS resolver resolves/binds/verifies source/schema/metric/unit/request/profile/rule/model-policy where present/split/horizon/pairs/counts/threshold/six roles/purpose/verifier provenance; then fresh served GET grade is derived from those artifacts.
V7_authentic: Require a real matched pair with same compatible estimand/design/time/purpose, training rows, method/version/params/seed, request/profile/rule, split/horizon, prediction points and intervals (same CI/nominal level), but actual heldout outcomes differ enough to change recomputed hits/rate and fresh grade across the issuer-bound threshold.

Do not substitute different nominal confidence, estimator shape, status/bool marker, fixture row, or unrelated cohort as the discriminator. One real holdout can support bounded V4 measurement but leaves V7's same-prediction/different-outcome grade property not_established.

E's predictive interval coverage does not calibrate a causal-effect CI by itself. For LA-051, only a method/design/estimand-compatible evaluation corpus can support empirical calibration; otherwise keep causal S10 limited and preserve purpose denials.

oracle_and_controls.oracle: Independently join actual source rows to persisted prediction intervals; compute each hit as lower <= observed <= upper, sum numerator/denominator, apply the issued rule threshold, and compare fresh consumer result. Keep other inputs fixed while varying only actual holdout outcomes. E's historical analytic oracle train 1..30 -> 31..34 with 4/4 vs synthetic 1000 -> 0/4 is fixture-only, not factual evidence.
oracle_and_controls.fake: Keep valid CAS hashes/schema/request/profile/evidence markers but forge counts/rate/floor/credible/hit flags. Fresh A resolver recomputes from loaded pairs and refuses or remains limited.
oracle_and_controls.foreign: Swap a content-valid but wrong-kind/non-admitted source/profile, wrong metric/unit/source_native scale, task population/geography, or method/rule/design while preserving markers; reject before ETS where preflight applies and never yield a positive fresh grade.
oracle_and_controls.stale: Use old source version/content, profile/request, changed rule/model/policy revision, stale valid time, or mismatched prediction/observation/calibration-window role while retaining old evidence/grade. Fresh resolver/readback rejects or downgrades with typed reason.
oracle_and_controls.removal: Remove actual lower<=observation<=upper pairing/count recomputation while keeping DTO/manifests/markers. The unchanged same-forecast/different-outcome assertion must fail. Keep E's unit-comparison removal as separate preflight property evidence; it does not replace V7 consumer falsifier.
oracle_and_controls.absence_vs_floor: Missing/unresolved ref produces a distinct typed reason from resolved evidence whose recomputed rate misses the issued floor; unresolved fake mapping refuses.
